Mathlib contributors: I’m seeking a review of mathlib4 #42165, which is one of my first mathlib contributions. The PR characterizes independence of random variables in terms of conditional distributions. Four declarations are added across two probability files. In addition there is a root import, totaling about 70 lines.

I welcome review from someone familiar with measure-theoretic probability, probability kernels, or conditional distributions. Feedback about the assumptions, names, and file locations is appreciated. The results are intended as a building block toward conditional-independence results used in causal inference. Will happily revise as needed. Thank you very much.

A gentle follow-up on mathlib4 #42165. The PR remains open with green CI. Not reviews yet. I particularly welcome feedback on the generality, naming, and location --- from anyone familiar with probability kernels or conditional distributions. Happy to revise as needed. Thanks!
